## Open data science for better transport

I am [Professor of Transport Data Science](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport/staff/953/professor-robin-lovelace) at the [Institute for Transport Studies](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport), University of Leeds.

I work with researchers, governments and communities to build open tools and reproducible methods for evidence-based transport planning.
Tools I have led or co-developed, including the [Propensity to Cycle Tool](https://www.pct.bike) and the [Network Planning Tool for Scotland](https://www.npt.scot), help plan cycling networks across the UK and beyond.

[Current projects](/projects/){.btn .btn-primary .me-2 .mb-2}
[Publications](/publications/){.btn .btn-outline-primary .me-2 .mb-2}
[What I am working on now](/now/){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .mb-2}

## Ways to get involved

::: {.activity-grid}
::: {.activity-card}
### Study and research

Interested in a PhD or Masters project on transport data science, active travel or open tools?
Read about the [Transport Data Science module](https://github.com/ITSLeeds/tds), then [get in touch](/contact/#study-and-research) with a short summary of your idea.
:::

::: {.activity-card}
### Collaborate

I work with public bodies, charities and companies on data, models and tools for sustainable transport.
See [current projects](/projects/) and [get in touch](/contact/#collaboration) to discuss an idea.
:::

::: {.activity-card}
### Use and contribute to open tools

Software such as [stplanr](https://docs.ropensci.org/stplanr/) and books such as [Geocomputation with R](https://r.geocompx.org/) are free and open source.
Questions, bug reports and contributions are welcome on [GitHub](https://github.com/robinlovelace) and the [geocompx Discord](https://discord.gg/PMztXYgNxp).
:::

::: {.activity-card}
### Talks and events

I speak about open tools, transport data and reproducible research.
See [past and upcoming events](/events/) and [invite me to speak](/contact/#talks-and-media).
:::
:::
